arguments.command:
if [ -d .git ] || git rev-parse --is-inside-work-tree > /dev/null 2>&1; then OUTPUT_TXT=$(git status) && CHANGES=$(git status --porcelain | wc -l) && STATUS=clean && [ $CHANGES -gt 0 ] && STATUS=dirty && tput cuu 1 && printf "
🌿 Git status:
%s
" "$OUTPUT_TXT" && termy_say "Git repository detected. You have $CHANGES uncommitted changes" > /dev/null 2>&1 && termy_set_context 'last_git_status' "$STATUS" && termy_set_context 'git_changes_count' "$CHANGES"; else tput cuu 1 && printf "⛔ Git status: Not a git repository

" && termy_say "Not a git repository" > /dev/null 2>&1; fi
arguments.explanation: Displays git status, caches dirty/clean state and change count for CI/CD workflows.
arguments.goal: Display git status with context preservation

arguments.command:

" && termy_say "Not a git repository" > /dev/null 2>&1; fi

arguments.command:

📁 Project directory path: " && read -r git_dir && if [ -d "$git_dir" ]; then cd "$git_dir" && git init && termy_say "Please enter the initial commit message" > /dev/null 2>&1 && printf "Initial commit message: " && read -r commit_msg && if [ -n "$commit_msg" ]; then git add . && git commit -m "$commit_msg" && printf "
Repository initialized with commit: \033[1m%s\033[22m
" "$commit_msg" && termy_say "Git repository initialized successfully" > /dev/null 2>&1; else printf "
⛔ Commit message cannot be empty.
" && termy_say "Operation cancelled" > /dev/null 2>&1; fi; else printf "
⛔ Directory does not exist.
" && termy_say "Directory not found" > /dev/null 2>&1; fi
